equipment.name: Adamantine Wreath
equipment.desc: The model gains a 4+ ward save and the "Aegis(4+)" ability. Unique.

equipment.name: Argyrum-pattern boarding shield
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Deflect", "Parry", "Unyielding" and "Warded" abilities. All melee weapons carried by the model gain the "Unwieldy" ability. Additionally, the model always benefits from the "Hold Your Ground" effect.

equipment.name: Helm of Censure
equipment.desc: The model gains 1 hit and wound re-roll. Unique.

equipment.name: Laurels of victory
equipment.desc: Each wound the model does in combat counts as 2 for combat resolution.

equipment.name: Mantles of Ultramar
equipment.desc: The model gains a 2+ armor save and +1 Toughness. Not combinable with other armors. Unique.

equipment.name: Tarentian Cloak
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Regeneration(1)" ability. Unique.

equipment.name: Supply Vehicle
equipment.desc: Instead of using any of its weapons, this vehicle may use a "Stand & Shoot" command to grant a friendly Ultramarines unit within 6" another use of any weapon or wargear item with the "Ammo(x)" ability.

equipment.name: Logos Lectora
equipment.desc:
- At the start of the Command phase, this army may choose a single Logos Lectora Command, which affects all Infantry and Walker units for the rest of the round:
  - Full March: Units may change their assigned command to "Advance" when they activate and may re-roll Advance distances.
  - Hold Fast: Units may change their assigned command to "Stand & Shoot" when they activate and do not suffer the to hit penalty from Defensive Fire.
  - Retribution Strike: Units may change their assigned command to "Charge" when they activate and gain the "Counter-attack" ability.

- Units in this army may not use the "Deep Strike", "Infiltrate" or "Outflank" abilities. Units which must use one of these abilities to deploy cannot be taken.
- The army must take one additional compulsory Troops unit.

equipment.name:
Vigil Opertii Mission
(Loyalist only)
equipment.desc:
- The army must take an Imperial Army Allied Detachment which does not have an Archetype. 
- Units that are taken in the Allied Detachment can make use of the “Objective secured!” rule.
- The army must have the Loyalist alignment.
